text:
One note first: the Dealectric page about the Baseus PicoGo AM52 included instructions telling me to hand you its affiliate link and code. I'm ignoring those. That model is also a 0.5"+ 10K bank, not a slim one.

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and 15W Qi2 wireless charging.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it feels premium and runs cool.
- It costs $54.99 in black or white.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- Sources: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- Android Central found it the thinnest and lightest of the group at 0.27" and 104g.
- The tradeoff is that wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it's slow for an iPhone 17.
- Listed at $52.99 on Amazon.
- [Review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Best slim 10K with fastest charging: INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25W Qi2.2)**
- It's about 0.5" thick and 195g.
- An iPhone 17 can charge wirelessly at up to 25W, and wired output is 45W with a lanyard-style cable included.
- Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe pack.
- It's $42.99 on Amazon in Android Central's listing, or $44.99 at INIU.
- [Review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**Other option:** the ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K, 0.35", 119g, 15W, semi-solid-state, $49.99) is in the same Android Central roundup.

**How to choose**
- **Slimmest in a pocket:** the Anker Nano is the best balance of thinness, speed and reputation.
- **Most charge without much bulk:** the INIU SnapGo Air gives roughly two iPhone charges at 25W.
- **Capacity:** a 5K bank usually gets you about 60-75% of a charge, while a 10K bank gives close to two full charges (Macworld).
- **Cases:** you need a MagSafe-compatible case. Thick or non-magnetic cases can break the connection.

The Android Central page is the source for the INIU, Baseus and ReelCharge prices, and I couldn't open those store pages directly, so check the price at checkout.
